--- page 2 ---
Have control. Let loose.
The WRX has all the hardware needed to corner with grace and speed.
Starting with the suspension, the WRX has an enviable setup—a rigid
unibody chassis with reinforced suspension mounting points, aluminum
front lower control arms with pillow-ball joint mounts, and a double
Cornering wishbone rear suspension architecture with pillow-ball joint bushings. And
with Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive and Active Torque Vectoring,
you’ll enjoy a seemingly endless supply of continuous traction.
Having excellent grip is only half of the handling equation. The other is the
driver’s sense of control and precision, which the WRX delivers, thanks
to a near-instant 14.4:1 steering ratio.1 With available 18-inch wheels2
and inverted front struts2 for less unsprung weight and more cornering
Responsiveness
response, the road will have to come to terms with your confidence.
Pure bliss exists in the form of the 268-hp 2.0-liter Direct-Injection
Turbocharged (DIT) SUBARU BOXER® engine, where power is generated
smoothly, efficiently and instantaneously, thanks to its twin-scroll
turbocharger. Matched with either the 6-speed manual transmission
Power
or the Sport Lineartronic™ Transmission with SI-DRIVE and paddle
shifters,2 the WRX intends to elevate every drive and heart rate.
The WRX backs up its potent performance features with appropriately
robust safety measures. With available LED Steering Responsive
Headlights (SRH)2 and High Beam Assist (HBA),2,3 the WRX can help
safely maximize your visibility at night. The standard Rear-Vision Camera
can help keep you aware of what’s behind you as you’re backing up.
Safety
And with available Blind-Spot Detection2,4 and Rear Cross-Traffic Alert,2,4
peace of mind in the WRX is just as possible as excitement.

are systems designed to assist the driver by monitoring the rear and side areas of the vehicle during a lane change or reversing and are not a substitute for safe and attentive driving.
